title: Reviewer and QA prompts: switch git worktree add to --detach <path> <sha> (bug #2)
definition_of_done: reference-impl/prompts/reviewer.md uses git worktree add --detach <path> <sha> exclusively; no git worktree add ... main or any named-branch form that could be held by the primary repo remains
reference-impl/prompts/qa.md uses git worktree add --detach <path> <sha> exclusively; no git worktree add ... main or any named-branch form that could be held by the primary repo remains
Changes pass the existing reference-impl test suite
acceptance_criteria: grep -n 'worktree add' reference-impl/prompts/reviewer.md shows only --detach forms; no match on 'worktree add.*main' (RFC AC #8)
grep -n 'worktree add' reference-impl/prompts/qa.md shows only --detach forms; no match on 'worktree add.*main' (RFC AC #8)
A simulated walker run inside a repo where main is already checked out does not produce 'fatal: branch ... is already checked out' errors from either the Reviewer or QA subagent prompt (RFC AC #8)
